:::{#def-circle}
#### Circle

For a [point](#def-real-coordinate-space) $\va \in \reals^2$ and a number $r > 0$,
the **circle**
[@wikipedia_circle]
with center $\va$ and radius $r$
is the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) of points in the [real plane](#def-real-coordinate-space) $\reals^2$
at [Euclidean distance](#def-euclidean-distance) $r$ from $\va$:

$$\cb{\vx \in \reals^2 : \norm{\vx - \va} = r}$$

:::
